title: Delivered text names the residue; the canon states each value the role concepts no longer carry
situation: The architect renamed the concept a concept's line carries from differentia to residue, defined as the symmetric difference between a concept's meaning and what its name invokes, and cut the workflow's role concepts down to each party's place among the parties, so a delivered agent's values have one source: the canon that composes it. The delivered text, the journal's explanation and the command reference still say differentia, and the composed agents lack some values the role concepts used to carry.
decision: (1) Every word the delivered agents, skills, harness notes, forms, the journal's explanation and the command reference show a reader that names the residue says residue; the journal's explanation of a concept's wording states the residue whole, what the name does not invoke and what it invokes that the concept does not have, and the signify skill's residue is the symmetric difference, the part the anchor fires that the concept lacks entering the body denied. Code identifiers and form keys stay. (2) Values are verified against the composed agents and added only where missing: conceptual integrity's gloss names Brooks's sense; the architect's rectify restates every input in the most precise established name; its role settles each meaning question on sight and works from the records and its delegates' returns, never the built work; the lead's role never writes a change itself; the builder's role writes the tests its change needs. Every other value the story names is already carried. (3) Two builders on disjoint paths: the canon and harness notes; the journal capability and its reference.
consequences: The personas over the architect inherit its additions; the checks pinning the composed text change with it.
